name: Soukou Akki Muramasa: Janen Hen
original_name: 装甲悪鬼村正 邪念編
source: The official anthology DVD of Soukou Akki Muramasa, which includes sidestories written by guest scenario writers, wallpapers, Twitter icons and backgrounds, new songs by Ono Masatoshi and VERTEUX and much more.
translation: 《装甲恶鬼村正》的官方选集DVD，收录客座剧本作者创作的支线故事、壁纸、Twitter图标与背景、小野正利和VERTEUX演唱的新曲等大量内容。
